title: Rabbi Yishmael bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 122a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.122a.19), Resh Lakish was sitting and considering a question. Rabbi Yishmael bar Abba answered him in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Resh Lakish replied, “Sit opposite me” (well done). Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Shimon bar Abba.

notes.text: Yishmael answers Resh Lakish in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2273&lang=en) also records. Resh Lakish then invites him to sit opposite him. “Well done” is Hyman’s explanation of that invitation.
The consulted Chullin passage has Yishmael. The Shimon reading in Dikdukei Soferim is reported by Hyman.
